snippet.title: Homebrew "Mai Nurse" Turbografx Master System
snippet.description:
Homebrew I made for SMSPower 2024 competition and ported to Turbografx16  :)
( 同人ゲーム開発  PCエンジン )

Download the roms here :
https://lunoka.itch.io/mai-nurse

Available for TG16,SMS,GG & GB.
